title: Akiyama Mizuki — Cascading Feelings〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? When did I fall asleep?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How was I able to get back, considering the state I was in?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It wasn't a dream, was it...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I talked to Ena, met the others in SEKAI, told them everything and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I finally got a chance to tell them...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, I got home and just collapsed on my bed because I was so tired.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait a second. I could've sworn I got back sometime in the evening yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What time is it now? Just before noon...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whaaat?! I was asleep for over half a day?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No wonder I feel so refreshed.
Still, that seems like way too much sleep.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I guess I needed to rest since I haven't been sleeping well at all for a while...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I mean, I was basically a zombie.
I couldn't tell if I was actually alive.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
I promised Ena that I'd log in to Nightcord once things have settled down.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It feels like it's been forever.
Alright, enter...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa...!
There's a bunch of messages!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I had a feeling that she'd do this, but I wasn't expecting her to send this many...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Welcome back... Unfortunately for you, we just started working on a new song, so there isn't much for you to do. I don't even have any assets for you yet...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <True. Which is why I did some thinking...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, K.
Mind if I made a short video for that song that got uploaded with a still-frame background?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, like one minute in length!
I thought it'd be a great way for new people to see what our songs are all about.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I see. In that case, if you don't mind.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Great! Can you send me your illustration, Enanan? Don't worry about the assets. I'll figure something out on my end.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Do you want the lyrics as well, Amia?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sorry, I gotta blow my nose. Be right back...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (My tear ducts probably still have their taps wide open because I cried so much yesterday...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You didn't sleep with the covers off or something, did you?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Not likely since I'm not the type who tosses and turns.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <If anything, I feel great because I slept for over half the day since yesterday♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Geez...
That means you didn't eat or drink anything at all during that time. How are you not a mummy by now?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I heard that it takes around seventy days for a person to become fully mummified...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha. That means I should be totally fine!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's not what I was getting at!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I really love spending time with the others like this.)
